# ShieldCaptcha

> Zero-dependency, multi-modal autonomous bot defense and enterprise Proof-of-Work platform.

ShieldCaptcha provides enterprise web applications with client-side Proof-of-Work (PoW) computation, interlocking jigsaw puzzles with computer-vision defense, and biomechanical kinematics trajectory analysis to distinguish human users from automated agents and scrapers.

## Core Documentation & Pages

- [Overview](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/): Enterprise bot mitigation overview, architecture highlights, and real-time live defense widget.
- [Interactive Demo](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/demo): Interactive live demonstration of 1-Click Turnstile verification and magnetic jigsaw puzzles.
- [Developer Documentation](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/docs): Comprehensive quickstart integration guides, REST API reference, and server verification endpoints.
- [Security Architecture](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/architecture): Deep technical breakdown of 4-layer defense: SHA-256 Proof-of-Work, AES-CBC-128 encryption, kinematics physics, and telemetry audits.
- [Integration Hub](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/integration): Framework guides and copy-paste code snippets for React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, and Python FastAPI.
- [Attack Simulator](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/simulator): Interactive defense lab testing resistance against headless browsers, synthetic click events, and teleportation attacks.
- [Security Policy & Vulnerability Disclosure](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/security): Cryptographic threat model, security posture, and 90-day responsible vulnerability disclosure policy.
- [Enterprise Trial](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/trial): Instant onboarding and credential provisioning for development and staging environments.
- [Contact & Support](https://shieldcaptcha.vercel.app/contact): Technical support channels and enterprise inquiries.

## Security & Architectural Guarantees

- **No Third-Party Tracking**: ShieldCaptcha stores zero personal data, sets no persistent tracking cookies, and operates with zero external network dependencies.
- **Stateless Verification**: Cryptographic HMAC-signed tokens enable instant serverless verification across distributed edge runtimes.
- **Proof-of-Work Resistance**: SHA-256 difficulty scales dynamically to eliminate automated bot scraping while maintaining sub-second human execution.

## Free CAPTCHA Alternative & Knowledge Base

- **Free CAPTCHA Service & APIs**: 100% free open-source CAPTCHA alternative to Google reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, and Cloudflare Turnstile.
- **Bot & Solver Resistance**: Resists automated headless bots (Selenium, Puppeteer, Playwright), OCR tools, and AI solvers through hardware canvas fingerprinting and micro-jitter drag kinematics.
- **Framework SDKs**: Official drop-in client components and SDKs for React, Next.js, Vue, Node.js, Express, Python FastAPI, and vanilla HTML/JavaScript.
- **Self-Hosting**: Zero-dependency Docker container and standalone Node/Python backends with full on-premises data sovereignity.
